messages:
Devon Patel: Quick ask 1 can someone assemble a concise onboarding runbook we can hand to high-risk accounts? Focus: account health checks, renewal red flags, and the customer-facing bits for caching/batching/streaming.

Sara Kim: On it. Ill make a one-pager + three copy-paste config presets (low/med/high). Keep it prescriptive and short.

Aisha Gomez: Please add a mandatory warmstart step. Customers often skip it and see first-call tail latency spikes. Recommend synthetic traffic for 5-15m.

Matt Chen: Also call out streaming tradeoffs clearly: streaming improves time-to-first-byte for interactive UIs but can complicate deterministic scoring. If they need exact full-text outputs for rerank/eval, recommend non-streaming.

Nina (CS Manager): Renewal triggers to include: persistent latency problems after onboarding, >10% error rate over 7d, or monthly usage <50% forecast with no business reason. Those should escalate to AE + enablement.

Sara Kim: Draft runbook checklist (short):
- Preflight: validate API keys, region match, KMS access, CORS and egress rules.
- Warmstart: run synthetic traffic for 5-15 minutes to populate KV/prefix caches.
- Prefetch: seed top N user prompts (we recommend top 20) into prefix/KV cache.
- Batching: conservative start (batch_size=4), iterate by monitoring p50/p95.
- Streaming: enable for chat/interactive demos; disable for deterministic batch scoring.
- Observability: enable per-route traces, token-level cost. Alert if p95 > 1.5x baseline or error rate > 5% for 24h.
- Renewal flags: repeated latency/errors, usage collapse, or billing disputes -> flag in CRM.

Devon Patel: Good. Can you paste three recommended presets we can paste in onboarding playbooks? Keep different names from other docs.

Sara Kim: Paste below 1 configs: demo/light, standard, bulk-throughput.

```
Demo/Light (interactive demo):
{
  "batch_size": 1,
  "target_first_byte_ms": 200,
  "kv_prefetch": true,
  "streaming": true,
  "warmup_minutes": 5
}

Standard (prod web app):
{
  "batch_size": 8,
  "target_p95_ms": 300,
  "kv_prefetch": true,
  "streaming": false,
  "warmup_minutes": 10
}

Bulk-Throughput (scoring/ingest pipelines):
{
  "batch_size": 48,
  "target_throughput_up_to": "customer-defined",
  "kv_prefetch": false,
  "streaming": false,
  "warmup_minutes": 20,
  "quantization_suggestion": "int8 or 4bit if model supports"
}
```

Aisha Gomez: Add note: keep prefix cache TTL high during initial onboarding (24-48h) to avoid cold UX, then reduce TTL to avoid stale content. Also document how to invalidate caches on prompt/template changes.

Matt Chen: Ops note: for customers on Dedicated, recommend an autoscale burst policy: +20-50% headroom for the first 72h of onboarding. Include a short curl harness they can run weekly to detect output/regression drift.

Matt Chen: sample curl harness:
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"prompts": ["Example prompt 1","Example prompt 2","Example prompt 3"], "max_tokens": 64, "stream": false}'
```

Sara Kim: Suggested CS workflow for 30/60/90 day checks:
1) CSM runs short health check template (latency, errors, usage trends).
2) If red flags, schedule joint troubleshooting with ENG/DevEx within 48h.
3) If usage falls >30% vs expected, AE outreach + 1-2 question feedback capture (latency rating + blockers).

Devon Patel: Can we include a tiny eval harness for CSMs (10 canonical prompts) to run weekly and track output-level regressions? Keep it as a curl + expected hash list.

Sara Kim: I'll build that and add to the doc. Also adding two customer examples for inclusion: 1) support chat that saved ~55% token cost after batching + prefix cache; 2) rerank pipeline where streaming was turned off to preserve deterministic scores.

Nina (CS Manager): Ownership and actions:
- Sara: produce the one-page runbook + PDF for CSMs (due by EOD Wed).
- Aisha: add warmstart checklist, TTL/invalidation steps, and copyable prefetch snippet (due Thu).
- Matt: add Dedicated autoscale policy example and curl harness with expected output checks (due Thu).
- Nina: encode renewal flag thresholds in CRM and share playbook for AE escalation (due Fri).

ops-bot: created task CS-1427 "Onboarding runbook: caching/batching/streaming" assigned to Sara Kim, due 2026-04-01.

Sara Kim: Uploading draft into #resources when ready. Will ping the AEs once integrated into the onboarding template.

Matt Chen: I'll drop the ops snippets into #eng-ops for review.

Aisha Gomez: I'll also collect the two anonymized customer case notes (cost/time numbers) for the doc.

Devon Patel: Thanks everyone 1 once it's in the template, we'll standardize this across AE handoffs. :white_check_mark:
